description: This file defines the IRemoteSiloProber interface in the Orleans runtime, which specifies methods for probing remote silos for responsiveness, including direct and indirect probing.

classes.name: IRemoteSiloProber
classes.description: Interface for probing remote silos to check their responsiveness, supporting direct and indirect probing methods.

methods.name: Probe
methods.description: Probes a specific silo for responsiveness asynchronously, returning a Task that completes upon success or failure.

methods.name: ProbeIndirectly
methods.description: Probes a target silo indirectly via an intermediary, with a specified timeout and diagnostic probe number.

calls: Task Probe(SiloAddress silo, int probeNumber, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
Task<IndirectProbeResponse> ProbeIndirectly(SiloAddress intermediary, SiloAddress target, TimeSpan probeTimeout, int probeNumber, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
